legacy_note: S12, S17 and S27 were POLICY_ASSERTED in RFC-EDGE-014: the artifacts they needed did not exist. Two of the three now exist (a real fill ledger and a real paper runtime), so all three are executed tests here, and the earlier declared grouping is left untouched in its own report
limitations: a detector that is written by the same author as the artifact can share its blind spots; the clean/tampered pairing removes the most common one
the suite tests this package's own evidence, not the engine internals
separation: every case in this suite is EXECUTED: a detector runs on the untouched artifact and on a mutated copy, and only a quiet-then-firing pair counts as a pass. There are no declared-only cases here
